subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Calendars — Odd Days, Day Finding and Leap Years (W10)

questions.stem: January 1, 2024 was a Monday, and 2024 is a leap year (366 days). What day of the week will January 1, 2025 fall on?
questions.explanation: C is correct. A leap year has 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 odd days. Each odd day shifts the weekday forward by 1. So Jan 1, 2025 = Monday + 2 = Wednesday. Trap: Tuesday (1 odd day, applies to ordinary years); Thursday adds 3 days by mistake.

questions.stem: How many leap years are there from 1900 to 2000 (both years inclusive)?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Leap year rule: divisible by 4; but century years must be divisible by 400. 1900 is divisible by 100 but NOT 400 → NOT a leap year. 2000 is divisible by 400 → IS a leap year. Leap years from 1904 to 2000 in steps of 4: (2000−1904)/4 + 1 = 25. Trap: 24 forgets to count 2000; 26 wrongly includes 1900.

questions.stem: If June 1, 2024 is a Saturday, on what day does September 1, 2024 fall?
questions.explanation: B is correct. From June 1 to Sep 1: June has 30 days, July has 31, August has 31. Total days from June 1 to Sep 1 = 30+31+31 = 92 days. 92 ÷ 7 = 13 weeks remainder 1. Saturday + 1 = Sunday. Trap: Saturday (0 odd days) assumes an even number of weeks; Monday (2) double-counts a month.

questions.stem: A month begins on a Wednesday and has 31 days. On what day does the month end?
questions.explanation: B is correct. If Day 1 = Wednesday, Day 31 = Wednesday + 30 days. 30 ÷ 7 = 4 weeks + 2 days. Wednesday + 2 = Friday. Quick check: Day 1=Wed, Day 8=Wed, Day 15=Wed, Day 22=Wed, Day 29=Wed, Day 30=Thu, Day 31=Fri ✓. Trap: Thursday (+1 day) confuses 31 days with 30 days.

questions.stem: August 15, 1947 (India's Independence Day) was a Friday. What day of the week was August 15, 1948?
questions.explanation: C is correct. From Aug 15, 1947 to Aug 15, 1948 spans through Feb 29, 1948 (1948 is a leap year). So exactly 366 days are counted. 366 = 52 weeks + 2 odd days. Friday + 2 = Sunday. Trap: Saturday (+1) applies to an ordinary year crossing; the span from Aug 15 to Aug 15 DOES include the leap day of 1948 (Feb 29, 1948 falls within this range).

questions.stem: January 1, 2000 was a Saturday. What day was January 1, 1996?
questions.explanation: B is correct. From Jan 1, 1996 to Jan 1, 2000 = 4 years. Odd days: 1996 (leap) = 2, 1997 = 1, 1998 = 1, 1999 = 1. Total = 5 odd days forward. To find 1996: go back 5 days from Saturday. Saturday − 5 = Monday (Sat→Fri→Thu→Wed→Tue→Mon). Trap: Sunday (−6 days) or Tuesday (−4 days) from off-by-one errors in counting leap years.

questions.stem: February 1, 2023 was a Wednesday. 2023 is not a leap year. How many Sundays were there in February 2023?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Feb 1 = Wednesday. First Sunday: Feb 1 + 4 = Feb 5 (Wed→Thu→Fri→Sat→Sun). Subsequent Sundays: Feb 5, 12, 19, 26. That is 4 Sundays. February 2023 had 28 days (non-leap), so Feb 26 + 7 = March 5 — outside the month. Trap: 5 Sundays would require 5 ≤ 1st Sunday ≤ 2, which would need Feb 1 or 2 to be Sunday — not the case here.

questions.stem: How many days are there from March 15 to July 25 in a non-leap year, counting both endpoints?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Days from March 15 to July 25 (inclusive): March 15 to 31 = 17 days; April = 30; May = 31; June = 30; July 1 to 25 = 25 days. Total = 17+30+31+30+25 = 133. Alternatively: March 15 is day 74 of a non-leap year; July 25 is day 206. 206−74+1 = 133. Trap: 132 forgets one endpoint; 130 misses the March tail.

questions.stem: In a non-leap year, January 1 is a Tuesday. On what day of the week does September 28 fall?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Days from Jan 1 to Sep 28: Jan(31)+Feb(28)+Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31)+Sep(1–28=28) = 271 days. Sep 28 is the 271st day. Days elapsed after Jan 1 = 270. 270 ÷ 7 = 38 weeks + 4 days. Tuesday + 4 = Saturday. Trap: Friday (+3) uses 269 days; Sunday (+5) over-counts by 1.

questions.stem: A person is born on February 29, 1984. He celebrates his birthday only on February 29. How many such birthdays has he completed (celebrated) by February 29, 2024, inclusive?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Leap years from 1984 to 2024 inclusive (every 4 years): 1984, 1988, 1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024 = 11 leap years. His 1st birthday was 1988 (not 1984, which was birth). So by Feb 29, 2024 he has completed 11 birthdays (1988 to 2024). Note: all these years pass the century-year test since none are divisible by 100 except 2000 (which IS a leap year, div. by 400). Trap: 12 counts birth year 1984 as a birthday; 10 stops at 2020.
